description: Energie - Schéma Eolien - Communauté Urbaine de Dunkerque is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. The first phase of the study of on-shore wind turbines in the Dunkirk CU territory, the wind scheme is the result of a spatial analysis taking into account all the current regulatory criteria allowing (or not) the installation of these structures. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Energy — Eolien scheme — Urban Community of Dunkirk" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include énergie renouvelable. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
